# tissue_mast_alert_source (Data Source)

An alert source or heartbeat by name, for wiring one made in the app into other configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tissue_mast_alert_source" "deploys" {
  name = "deploys"
}

# Hand the URL to whatever sends to it.
resource "local_sensitive_file" "mast_url" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.mast-url"
  content  = data.tissue_mast_alert_source.deploys.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the alert source or heartbeat.

### Read-Only

- `heartbeat` (Boolean) Whether it is a heartbeat.
- `id` (String) Its id, `mc_...`.
- `kind` (String) The API's word for what it is: `channel` for an alert source, or `vital` for a heartbeat.
- `policy_id` (String) The policy it follows, or empty.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The ingest URL, key included.
